findings.priority_reason: Before benchmark pass is used as product acceptance.
findings.title: Aggregate structural pass can accept wrong order and undelivered required artifacts
findings.root_cause: Gold represents producer membership/use-anywhere, not required source->consumer edges or final delivery; no separate semantic gate.
findings.condition: A plan contains required entries but creates artifacts before research and delivers research only.
findings.consequence: Benchmark pass is not evidence of request fulfilment; optimizing it can select semantically wrong plans.
findings.counterevidence: Scorer explicitly disclaims prose semantics and finalArtifact is documented as any adopted output; this is a metric/acceptance gap, not a claim of mock runtime failure.
findings.fix: Keep structural checks; add evaluator-only permitted dependency/delivery constraints where explicit, plus separate blind LLM or human semantic review. Never add scenario-keyword judgement to product code.
findings.verification: Wrong-flow counterexample fails dependency/delivery or semantic evaluation while valid alternatives pass; producer prompts never receive gold. Two metrics reported separately.

impacts.reason: Primary evaluation verdict does not cover required fulfilment contract.
Missing negative controls for required relation and delivery.

findings.priority_reason: Before the next evaluation or integration handoff relies on this behavior.
findings.title: Export attributes current gold to an old run without detecting drift
findings.root_cause: Case content/scorer revision not pinned at run creation; export reads current cases.
findings.condition: Cases change after run, same run exported again.
findings.consequence: Unchanged historical scores can be accompanied by a new gold hash and clean cross-check, weakening reproducibility and audit.
findings.counterevidence: Immutable DB prevents score rewrites and file digest identifies export-time cases, but not cases used by run.
findings.fix: Record evaluator-only case hashes and code/scorer revision at run start; compare at export, retain snapshot/reference or flag old runs unknown.
findings.verification: Changing a case after run must produce explicit drift error or use original pinned snapshot; old scores cannot claim new gold.

impacts.reason: Cross-check cannot detect changed test expectations.

findings.priority_reason: Before the next evaluation or integration handoff relies on this behavior.
findings.title: Strict JSON __proto__ property changes local object prototype and outcome
findings.root_cause: Object constructed as {} with out[key] assignment and inherited status read.
findings.consequence: Key lost as own data, inherited authoring status accepted; JSON/YAML outcome comparison and validation can be distorted.
findings.counterevidence: Bench-only parser; no global prototype pollution or real tool privilege escalation demonstrated.
findings.fix: Construct safe own-property data (Object.create(null) or defineProperty/standard parse plus duplicate-key detection), and discriminate outcomes on own fields.
findings.verification: __proto__, constructor/prototype and escaped-key fixtures preserve native JSON data meaning without inherited status; normal/duplicate-key/depth checks retain behavior.

impacts.reason: Input controls allow inherited discriminator values.

findings.priority_reason: Before the next evaluation or integration handoff relies on this behavior.
findings.title: Default offline test gate relies on untracked external tokenizer files
findings.root_cause: Fake runner tests do not supply their own tokenizer/source fixtures.
findings.consequence: Required check:all exits1 even without optional model measurements, preventing portable regression gate.
findings.counterevidence: Other326 tests, type/lint/format and bench87 checks pass; production countTokens correctly returns null.
findings.fix: Use temporary fixtures and explicit env for unit tests; keep absent-file tests; make real-tokenizer integration separate.
findings.verification: Fresh checkout with no tokenizer env/files passes all offline tests and missing tokenizer returns null, with no skip/weakened assertion.

impacts.reason: Install/check lifecycle requires hidden external fixture.

findings.priority_reason: Before the next evaluation or integration handoff relies on this behavior.
findings.title: Canonical current-stage documents contradict implementation and handoffs
findings.root_cause: Entry docs/plan not reconciled with p0-2/P1-P4 work and changed target-model acceptance.
findings.condition: Maintainer follows README or plan current-state sections.
findings.consequence: Wrong assumptions about fixed contracts, remaining work and measurement target cause avoidable investigation/rework.
findings.counterevidence: Detailed dated handoffs identify actual evidence and gaps; core comments are clearer.
findings.fix: Update canonical current-state/decision index, distinguish library completion from model/dispatch acceptance, point to final decisions and experimental conditions.
findings.verification: README/plan/AGENTS/index agree on p0-2, latest target model class, unfinished live integration and evidence status.

impacts.reason: Main entry documents misstate current contracts.
New integrators cannot determine accurate prerequisites and stage.

findings.priority_reason: Before the next evaluation or integration handoff relies on this behavior.
findings.title: Later selection recommendation reuses exposed holdout for tuning/acceptance
findings.root_cause: Post-P4 follow-up sweeps k on an already viewed holdout and uses its result as adoption condition.
findings.condition: Union k3..6 evaluated against same holdout after original freeze.
findings.consequence: 94.1% is valid posthoc inclusion observation but cannot serve as independent fresh final estimate of selected improvement.
findings.counterevidence: Dev also chooses k5 and original P4 one-pass result stays valid; not proof that k was chosen solely from holdout or that improvement is false.
findings.fix: Label reused holdout diagnostic; freeze final configuration and assess once on new sealed group-separated cases and exact target model, including compose outcomes.
findings.verification: Predeclared immutable config/cases and new holdout hashes, no parameter choice from new final results; old/new numbers separated.

impacts.reason: Final-generalization evidence requires independent held-out evaluation.
Posthoc proxy gains should not replace target-model validation.
